claims: Lockheed Martin built the Orion crew capsule for Artemis II.
The European Space Agency (ESA) and Airbus manufactured the European Service Module (ESM).
The European Service Module (ESM) provides power and propulsion.
Boeing constructed the core stage of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket for NASA.
Northrop Grumman constructed the boosters of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket for NASA.
Lockheed Martin developed the Orion Crew Module in Littleton, Colorado.
Airbus built the European Service Module (ESM).
The European Service Module (ESM) provides electricity, water, and propulsion.
Northrop Grumman manufactured the SLS Rocket Boosters.
Lockheed Martin built the Launch Abort System.
United Launch Alliance (ULA) provided propulsion systems.
The spacecraft is designed to carry four astronauts on a 10-day mission around the Moon.
